senses.gloss: f. pl. (קבט, v. קָבוּט) pressed or pickled substances, sauces &c.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:8:5">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41ᵈ</cite> <he>ק׳ … שלהן</he> sauces (or pickles) prepared by gentiles; <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:11">Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:11">V</cite>), 11 <cite ref="S01729"><he>קַפְטָאוֹת</he></cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="S01698"><he>קפאטיות</he></cite>, missing in oth. eds.); Bab.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 3:2:5">Y. Pes. III, 30ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ בירתייות וכ׳</he> sauces from Birtha must be removed before Passover (on account of an admixture of leavened matter); cmp. <cite ref="Q00975"><he>פְּלוּלִינַיָּא</he></cite>.
